authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Generic cEDH staples are justified only where the source found them to beat commander-specific cards (decisions L13).
Keep the creature/Vehicle balance: Vehicles without crew don't count.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: A wipe takes out the creature/Vehicle board Edward counts.
Mandatory draws during a loop can deck you.
mitigations: Watch library size; skip Fateful Discovery mid-loop

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Creatures that crew can't also attack; Vehicles without crew are dead.

value.interaction: Free and cheap counters (Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Swan Song) and removal Vehicles.
value.mana: Premium fast mana (Mana Vault, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Lotus Petal) and Edward's Treasures.
value.protection: Deflecting Swat, Fierce Guardianship, Cavern of Souls for Pirates.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Edward converts every tapped Assassin, Pirate and Vehicle into Treasure and is half of the Edward + Time Sieve extra-turn loop.
accepted_role.honest_note: Several of the deck's infinite lines (Reaver Cleaver, Luxurious Locomotive, Hoard Hauler + Time Sieve; Malcolm + Glint-Horn) work without Edward, and the ten-Game-Changer card pool does much of the lifting.
